title: Student Data Privacy Principles
description: Four practices, four specific risks. Click any one to see exactly which failure it prevents.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

educational.audience: Mentors and club leaders handling student data

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given one of the four student data privacy practices, the learner explains the specific risk that practice reduces.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin hub-and-spoke diagram naming the risk each practice closes
pedagogical.assessment: Name a failure and ask which of the four practices would have prevented it.
